**The fix:**
```js
const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, discountPercent)); // clamp 0–100
const discount = Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100);      // round to nearest cent
return Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);
```

**Tests added** (all passing):
- 2×1000 @ 10% → 1800 (the original failing case)
- 0% → 2000 (no change)
- 100% → 0
- −25% → 2000 (clamped to 0)
- 150% → 0 (clamped to 100)
- 999 @ 15% → 849 (rounds 149.85 → 150 discount)
